Representative ooRexx Maths v0.8 outcomes

Exact:
  1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 -> 3/3 -> MathInteger 1
  (2/3) * 3 / 2 -> MathInteger 1
  2/3 exact expansion -> 0.(6)

Quantized:
  INT8/NF4 retain scheme + state + exact reconstruction-error evidence over represented values.

3D:
  90-degree Z quaternion * [1,0,0] -> [0,1,0] at the retained Maths precision.
  T*R*S uses column-vector semantics (S, then R, then T).
  Perspective convention is explicit: OpenGL RH z[-1,+1], Vulkan RH z[0,+1], DirectX LH z[0,+1].
  Caller NUMERIC DIGITS 9 does not override a 50-digit MathContext inside v0.8 3D arithmetic.
